title: enform instance.started@1 event payload
description: The payload of an instance.started@1 event (#43, #177, #187, S06, FM-7, DF-2, DX-1, I13). It names the instance that the event started, by the id that the client minted (DX-1, #187). A start routes a draft to the first step whose skip condition is false (WF-1), stamps the instance with its definition version and resolved assignees (DF-2, I13), names the starter (AC-5), and records the values that the form holds (FM-7).

instanceId.description: The id that identifies the instance, minted by the client that started it (DX-1, #187). It is not the operation id: the operation id names one change, the instance id names the instance that the change acts on.

definitionVersion.description: The content hash of the definition version that the instance started on (DF-2).

currentStep.description: The key of the step that the start routed the draft to (WF-1, S06).

assignees.description: The resolved assignees of the first active step, with their membership snapshots (I13, AS-4).

starter.description: The principal that started the instance (S06, AC-5).

values.description: The values that the form holds: one field key to one JSON value (FM-7).

jsonValue.description: One JSON value: a string, number, boolean, null, array or object (FM-7, DF-1).

assignee.description: One resolved assignee of a step, with the membership snapshot that resolution produced (I13, AS-4).

target.description: A task recipient: exactly one kind, per AS-1. Dynamic targets are starter, field and manager-of.
